license_required.quote: No person may practice or offer to practice geology or soil science in the State without a current license issued under this chapter, unless specifically exempted from the license requirement by this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: State Board of Licensure for Geologists and Soil Scientists
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Licensure for Geologists and Soil Scientists.

name.value: State Board of Licensure for Geologists and Soil Scientists
name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Licensure for Geologists and Soil Scientists.

type.quote: The State Board of Licensure for Geologists and Soil Scientists as established by Title 5, section 12004‑A, subsection 19 shall administer this chapter. The board consists of 7 members, 5 of whom are appointed by the Governor from the following categories: One academic geologist; one independent consultant or salaried geologist; one independent consultant or salaried soil scientist; one other soil scientist; and a public member

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant for licensure as a geologist or soil scientist must be trustworthy and competent.

degree_required.value: Minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree from an accredited college or university in soils, plants, engineering, geology, biology, forestry or other natural resources science (or associate degree pathway with longer experience)
degree_required.quote: A minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree from an accredited college or university in soils, plants, engineering, geology, biology, forestry or other natural resources science

accrediting_body.quote: A minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree from an accredited college or university

degree_level.quote: Completed an associate degree from an accredited 2-year college in soils, plants, engineering, geology, biology, forestry or other natural resources science

school_approval_basis.quote: from an accredited college or university

credential_pegged.quote: A minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree from an accredited college or university in soils, plants, engineering, geology, biology, forestry or other natural resources science

exams.name: National Fundamentals of Soil Science Examination
exams.notes: May be taken in the final year prior to or after graduation from an accredited 2-year program or in the final year of an accredited 4-year or graduate-level program, as long as the applicant has completed the minimum 15 credit hours.
exams.quote: An applicant under this subsection may take a national fundamentals of soil science examination approved in rules adopted by the board

exams.name: National Soil Science Professional Practice Examination
exams.notes: May be taken upon completion of the work experience requirement.
exams.quote: An applicant under this subsection may take a national soil science professional practice examination and Maine soil science professional practice examination approved in rules adopted by the board upon completion of the work experience requirement in this subsection.

exams.name: Maine Soil Science Professional Practice Examination
exams.notes: State local knowledge examination; may be taken upon completion of work experience requirement.
exams.quote: a national soil science professional practice examination and Maine soil science professional practice examination approved in rules adopted by the board upon completion of the work experience requirement in this subsection.

available.quote: the board, in accordance with Title 10, section 8003‑H and any applicable rules adopted pursuant to that section, shall establish a process to issue a license by endorsement for each license authorized under this chapter

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement available; board may also issue license without written examination to any person licensed as a soil scientist in any jurisdiction having equivalent licensure requirements, upon payment of applicable fees and satisfaction of all other requirements.
requirements.quote: the board, in its discretion and upon payment of the application and license fees established pursuant to section 4912, may issue a license as a geologist or soil scientist without written examination to any person who is licensed as a geologist or soil scientist in any jurisdiction having equivalent licensure requirements, if the applicant satisfies all other requirements of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: "Licensed soil scientist" means a person entitled under this chapter to take and use the title "licensed soil scientist."

scope_protection.quote: No person may practice or offer to practice geology or soil science in the State without a current license issued under this chapter, unless specifically exempted from the license requirement by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may deny, refuse to renew, or impose disciplinary sanctions for reasons enumerated in Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5-A, paragraph A.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may deny a license, refuse to renew a license or impose the disciplinary sanctions authorized by Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5‑A for any of the reasons enumerated in Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5‑A, paragraph A.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of soil science" means any professional service that requires the application of soil science principles and data. "Practice of soil science" includes identification and mapping of soils according to the standards of the National Cooperative Soil Survey, consultation or evaluation.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of soil science" means any professional service that requires the application of soil science principles and data. "Practice of soil science" includes identification and mapping of soils according to the standards of the National Cooperative Soil Survey, consultation or evaluation.

methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of soil science" includes identification and mapping of soils according to the standards of the National Cooperative Soil Survey, consultation or evaluation.

trainee_exam_type.quote: An applicant under this subsection may take a national fundamentals of soil science examination approved in rules adopted by the board

minimum_soil_science_credit_hours.quote: Completed a minimum of 15 credit hours of soil or soil-related courses.

teaching_or_research_counts_as_experienc.quote: An applicant who teaches soil science courses at a college or university offering a 4-year degree in soil science may receive credit toward the required work experience under this subparagraph.

advanced_degree_experience_credit.quote: Each graduate degree obtained in a soil or soil-related field in addition to the required 4-year baccalaureate degree counts as one year of work experience.

subordinate_definition_included.quote: "Subordinate" means any person who assists a licensed geologist or soil scientist without assuming the responsible charge of work.

responsible_charge_definition_included.quote: "Responsible charge of work" means the independent control and direction by the use of initiative, skill and independent judgment of work or the supervision of such work.

firm_corporation_practice_allowed.quote: This chapter does not prohibit one or more geologists or soil scientists from practicing through the medium of a sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation or government agency.

firm_certificate_of_authorization_requir.quote: This chapter does not prohibit one or more geologists or soil scientists from practicing through the medium of a sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation or government agency.

nonresident_practice_exempt_days.quote: practicing or offering to practice in the profession of geologist or soil scientist when that practice does not exceed in the aggregate more than 30 days in any calendar year

national_cooperative_soil_survey_standar.quote: "Practice of soil science" includes identification and mapping of soils according to the standards of the National Cooperative Soil Survey

seal_or_stamp_required_on_documents.quote: All soil science maps, reports or documents that are prepared by a licensed soil scientist or by a subordinate under the licensed soil scientist's direction must be signed by the licensed soil scientist, which indicates the licensed soil scientist's responsibility for them.

board_includes_public_member.quote: One academic geologist; one independent consultant or salaried geologist; one independent consultant or salaried soil scientist; one other soil scientist; and a public member as defined in Title 5, section 12004‑A.

board_includes_ex_officio_state_soil_sci.quote: The 6th and 7th members are the State Soil Scientist employed in State Government, ex officio, and the State Geologist or the State Geologist's designee, who must be a geologist employed in State Government, ex officio.

combined_board_with_related_professions.quote: The State Board of Licensure for Geologists and Soil Scientists as established by Title 5, section 12004‑A, subsection 19 shall administer this chapter.
